fresh_pg18_per_suite.bash:
cutover_owned_pg() (
  set -euo pipefail
  set +x
  umask 077
  cutover_case=$1; cutover_mode=$2; cutover_bindings=$3; shift 3
  [[ $cutover_case =~ ^[a-z0-9-]+$ ]]
  cutover_private=$(mktemp -d /tmp/wamn-cutover-pg.XXXXXXXX)
  cutover_container_id=
  cutover_cleanup() {
    cutover_rc=$?
    if [[ -n $cutover_container_id ]]; then
      docker rm --force --volumes "$cutover_container_id" >/dev/null || cutover_rc=1
    fi
    rm -rf -- "$cutover_private"
    exit "$cutover_rc"
  }
  trap cutover_cleanup EXIT
  trap 'exit 130' INT
  trap 'exit 143' TERM
  PGPASSWORD=$(python3 -c 'import secrets; print(secrets.token_hex(24))')
  printf 'POSTGRES_PASSWORD=%s\n' "$PGPASSWORD" > "$cutover_private/postgres.env"
  cutover_extra=()
  case $cutover_mode in
    plain|two-databases) ;;
    scs-off) cutover_extra=(-c standard_conforming_strings=off) ;;
    *) exit 2 ;;
  esac
  cutover_container_id=$(docker run --detach --name "wamn-cutover-${cutover_case}-$(date -u +%Y%m%d%H%M%S)-$$" --env-file "$cutover_private/postgres.env" --publish 127.0.0.1::5432 postgres:18 "${cutover_extra[@]}")
  cutover_address=$(docker port "$cutover_container_id" 5432/tcp)
  [[ $cutover_address =~ ^127\.0\.0\.1:([0-9]+)$ ]]
  PGPORT=${BASH_REMATCH[1]}
  export PGHOST=127.0.0.1 PGPORT PGUSER=postgres PGPASSWORD PGDATABASE=postgres PGCONNECT_TIMEOUT=2
  cutover_deadline=$((SECONDS + 90))
  until psql --no-psqlrc --set ON_ERROR_STOP=1 --tuples-only --command 'SELECT 1' > /dev/null 2>&1; do
    (( SECONDS < cutover_deadline )) || { printf '%s\n' 'Owned PostgreSQL readiness timed out' >&2; exit 1; }
    sleep 1
  done
  export CUTOVER_PG_BASE_URL="postgresql://postgres:${PGPASSWORD}@127.0.0.1:${PGPORT}"
  export CUTOVER_PG_ADMIN_URL="${CUTOVER_PG_BASE_URL}/postgres"
  if [[ $cutover_mode == two-databases ]]; then
    psql --no-psqlrc --set ON_ERROR_STOP=1 --command 'CREATE DATABASE bind_project' --command 'CREATE DATABASE bind_control'
  fi
  unset WAMN_PG_URL DATABASE_URL WAMN_PG_TEST_URL
  IFS=, read -r -a cutover_assignments <<< "$cutover_bindings"
  for cutover_assignment in "${cutover_assignments[@]}"; do
    cutover_name=${cutover_assignment%%=*}; cutover_database=${cutover_assignment#*=}
    [[ $cutover_name =~ ^WAMN_[A-Z0-9_]+$ && $cutover_database =~ ^[a-z_]+$ ]]
    export "$cutover_name=${CUTOVER_PG_BASE_URL}/${cutover_database}"
    [[ -n ${!cutover_name} ]]
    printf 'armed %s on owned PostgreSQL port %s\n' "$cutover_name" "$PGPORT"
  done
  "$@"
)
